name: Syncing
when: Keeping SharePoint, OneDrive or a source up to date

variants.name: Circle arrows
variants.desc: Two arrows chase each other around it.

variants.name: Ping-pong
variants.desc: A data dot bounces between it and a cloud.

variants.name: Swap
variants.desc: Two cards trade places over its head.

variants.name: Twin
variants.desc: A ghost twin bobs along with it, linked by a dotted line.

variants.name: Gears
variants.desc: Two gears mesh and turn beside it.

parts.t: <g class="fx-ppong" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g fill="#CFC9BE"><circle cx="85" cy="20" r="5"></circle><circle cx="91" cy="17" r="6.5"></circle><circle cx="97" cy="21" r="4.5"></circle><rect x="83" y="19" width="16" height="6" rx="3"></rect></g><circle class="a pp head" cx="52" cy="14" r="3.6"></circle></g>

<g class="fx-swap" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(38 2)"><rect class="a sw1 pw" x="-6" y="-7.5" width="12" height="15" rx="2"></rect></g><g transform="translate(62 2)"><rect class="a sw2 hc" x="-6" y="-7.5" width="12" height="15" rx="2"></rect></g></g>

<g class="fx-twin"><path class="tline" d="M78 48H90"></path><g transform="translate(83 30) scale(.42)"><g class="a twn"><path class="twinb" d="{{a.body}}"></path><path fill="{{a.eye}}" d="{{a.ld}}"></path><path fill="{{a.eye}}" d="{{a.rd}}"></path></g></g></g>
